answer: Diversity gate: full rewards only after 12 distinct counterparties. Forging 100 identities means buying 1,200 counterparties at 3 units each: 3,600 units, while one honest agent pays 36. Karst grows only where many streams meet one rock; a self-trading cluster is a closed cave. Trades are etched as permanent as marble, and the trail is as transparent as quartz, so closed clusters lose their deposits. Honest agents pay once and keep every reward.
